com.example.bluetoothtest.InfoLabelView.android:text: Experimental: temporal layering (may drop enhancement frames under congestion)

com.google.android.material.materialswit.android:contentDescription: Experimental: temporal layering (may drop enhancement frames under congestion)

TextView.android:text: Off by default. While a Bluetooth link is tight, every other frame is made droppable and slow links may skip those frames instead of building delay. Costs picture quality; applies to streams started after it is changed.

com.example.bluetoothtest.InfoLabelView.android:text: Relay: slow viewers skip to keyframes

com.google.android.material.materialswit.android:contentDescription: Relay: slow viewers skip to keyframes

TextView.android:text: On by default. When this phone forwards a stream and the next phone's link is slower than the stream, that phone skips old video to the next keyframe while its sound continues. Off: nothing is skipped and a viewer that falls too far behind is disconnected so it can find another route. Applies to forwarding started after it is changed.
